response.rationale: For the spice sense, Indonesian commonly uses “merica,” while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “lada.” This is a useful national preference distinction.
response.risk_rationale: “Lada” appears in some Indonesian compounds, especially “lada hitam,” so usage overlap exists without undermining the core contrast.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Merica” may be understood in Malaysian Malay, but “lada” is the ordinary Malaysian term; Indonesian uses “merica” as the usual standalone term for this spice.
